name: AvianAction101
description: This dataset utilizes social media videos to investigate behavior of Rose-ringed parakeet(Psittacula krameri), offering a unique opportunity to understand their social interactions, emotional expressions, and environmental adaptability through collection of real and natural behavioral data. To support this, a video action analysis dataset for Rose-ringed parakeet has been designed. The dataset comes from 381 short videos, divided into 1249 action video slices, covering 15 courtship-related action categories (such as head nodding, spread wings, and shaking, etc.), Videos were retained in their original resolutions (not standardized), providing a realistic benchmark for robustness testing in computer-vision models, enabling research in behavior recognition, video detection and pattern analysis.
